friction: No guess was needed: the build was green on the first run. What cost time: (1) finding a component's real doc comment and its props: the skill says "doc comment first", but in ComboBox, Card, Chip, TopAppBar and Button the first comment is about styles or a helper type, and props are only in the type further down; a short props table in each main comment, or the main comment first in the file, would do. (2) The address case is documented well, in the adapter and in ComboBox, but stops short of three things I had to work out or leave unverified: the hand-bound field cannot take react-hook-form's focus because FocusAnchor is private (export it, or show `field.ref` in the example); which callback a pick fires and what it does to `inputValue`; and that the built-in contains-filter still runs over suggestions a service already filtered, with no loading state for the menu. (3) Nothing says how a multi-step form is put together: Stepper + the adapter + `trigger` per step + where the focus goes on a step change; a paragraph in the stepper block's comment would cover it. (4) RadioTile's group wraps the kit's RadioGroup only: a form-bound variant, and a disabled tile whose text fades, had to be added. (5) For a delivery slot the kit offers DatePicker and TimePicker by name, and neither says it is for a free date or clock time rather than a choice among offered slots; one line pointing to the radio tile block for that would save the detour. (6) `npx shadcn@latest add @ds/stepper-block @ds/radio-tile-block -y` was refused by this session's permission layer before it ran; the two blocks were copied from kit-blocks/, which made that harmless. (7) The stepper block overflows a 400px phone with four steps, and a Disclosure inside a Card (or the kit's own outlined Disclosure) has its focus ring clipped: both were found by reading classes and summing widths, not by anything the comments say. Nothing could be seen running: no browser was allowed, so every part is type-checked and rendered once on the server only.
